    CodeAffichageDéfinition
    SP-2010-4060Création/agrandissement de communication interatrialeCreation of an atrial septal defect or enlargement of an existing atrial septal defect using a variety of modalities including balloon septostomy, blade septostomy, or surgical septectomy. Creation may be accomplished with or without use of cardiopulmonary bypass.
    SP-2010-5640Cerclage de l'artère pulmonairePlacement of a pulmonary artery band, any type.
    SP-2010-5590Anastomose systémico-pulmonaire de Blalock-Taussig modifiée (MBTS)Placement of a tube graft from a branch of the aortic arch to the pulmonary artery with or without bypass, from any approach (thoracotomy, sternotomy).
    SP-2010-4870Intervention de NorwoodThe Norwood operation is synonymous with the term 'Norwood (Stage 1)' and is defined as an aortopulmonary connection and neoaortic arch construction resulting in univentricular physiology and pulmonary blood flow controlled with a calibrated systemic-to-pulmonary artery shunt, or a right ventricle to pulmonary artery conduit, or rarely, a cavopulmonary connection. When coding the procedure 'Norwood procedure', the primary procedure of the operation should be 'Norwood procedure'. The second procedure (Procedure 2 after the Norwood procedure) must then document the source of pulmonary blood flow and be chosen from the following eight choices: 1. Shunt, Systemic to pulmonary, Modified Blalock- Taussig Shunt (MBTS) 2. Shunt, Systemic to pulmonary, Central (from aorta or to main pulmonary artery) 3. Shunt, Systemic to pulmonary, Other 4. Conduit placement, RV to PA 5. Bidirectional cavopulmonary anastomosis (BDCPA) (bidirectional Glenn) 6. Glenn (unidirectional cavopulmonary anastomosis) (unidirectional Glenn) 7. Bilateral bidirectional cavopulmonary anastomosis (BBDCPA) (bilateral bidirectional Glenn) 8. HemiFontan
    SP-2010-5680Anastomose cavopulmonaire unidirectionnelle (Glenn unidirectionnel)Superior vena cava to ipsilateral pulmonary artery anastomosis (i.e., LSVC to LPA, RSVC to RPA).
    SP-2010-5670Anastomose cavopulmonaire bidirectionnelle (Glenn bidirectionnel)Superior vena cava to pulmonary artery anastomosis allowing flow to both pulmonary arteries with an end-to-side superior vena-to-pulmonary artery anastomosis.
    SP-2010-5690Anastomose cavopulmonaire bidirectionnelle bilatéraleBilateral superior vena cava-to-pulmonary artery anastomoses (requires bilateral SVCs).
    SP-2010-5000Fontan (TCPC), conduit extracardiaque, fenestréTotal cavopulmonary connection using an external conduit to connect the infradiaphragmatic systemic venous return to the pulmonary artery, with fenestration.
    SP-2010-5010Fontan (TCPC), conduit extracardiaque, non fenestréTotal cavopulmonary connection using an external conduit to connect the infradiaphragmatic systemic venous return to the pulmonary artery, with no fenestration.
    SP-2010-4970Fontan (TCPC), tunnel latéral, fenestréTotal cavopulmonary connection using an intraatrial lateral tunnel construction, with fenestration.
    SP-2010-4980Fontan (TCPC), tunnel latéral, non fenestréTotal cavopulmonary connection using an intraatrial lateral tunnel construction, with no fenestration.
    SP-2010-4520Réparation à un ventricule et demiPartial biventricular repair; includes intracardiac repair with bidirectional cavopulmonary anastomosis to volume unload a small ventricle or poorly functioning ventricle.
    SP-2010-5710Palliation, autreAny other palliative procedure not specifically listed.

name: TaussigCardiacCondition
title: TAUSSIG — CardiacCondition (lésions résiduelles/acquises/post-chir)
description: Working set des conditions cardiaques évolutives de la POC (distinct du diagnostic congénital figé) : 61 lésions résiduelles/acquises codées en IPCCC, plus 13 états d'étape chirurgicale codés en ECHSA — l'IPCCC ne code pas l'état « status post » d'un montage (Fontan, Glenn, MBTS…), d'où un ValueSet multi-systèmes. ICD-10 = donnée dérivée (crossmap IPCCC). Le typage residual/acquired/post-chir est un choix clinicien à la saisie (CardiacCondition.condition_type), pas une propriété du code.
